items.title: Houston Person Part 2 interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 2, 1998 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: they’ve got a forceful guy down there, Wynton, he keeps on fighting.

ctx.x: She can start with you, right? © Fillius Jazz Archive -5-

Yes. They are sort of interested. But they are going their own way, which is fine with me. But back to Lincoln Center, I think they’re doing a wonderful job there. And especially with the kids programs. And they do as much as they can and they’ve got a forceful guy down there, Wynton, he keeps on fighting. And Jon Faddis, I like what he’s doing too. So there are two guys who are really making big contributions. And they have people who they’re responsible to. But they do what they can, and they do some wonderful…
I think I saw a thing in the New York Times recently that they had done a concert with a dance venue — people were doing the Swing dance out —
